patch_list: 5.1-channel audio bridge (4XVR)
Switches 4XVR video playback to 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Audio bridge payload (4XVR)

Adds the bundled sound engine that lets 4XVR play 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Frame-synced render dispatch (4XVR)

Syncs scene changes and screen updates to the display's frame rhythm, keeping playback smooth. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Galaxy XR controller models (4XVR)

Replaces the Quest 3 controller artwork and shapes with the Galaxy XR controller models. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Galaxy XR launch compatibility (4XVR)

Installs the standard XR files 4XVR needs to start on Galaxy XR instead of closing right after opening. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Galaxy XR launcher icon (4XVR)
Restores the proper 4XVR icon on the device's app launcher and in the patch manager. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)
Runs 4XVR's picture at Galaxy XR's native 72 Hz rate instead of 60 Hz. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)

Adds the HDR video component and its open-source notices; built on libplacebo (LGPL-2.1-or-later). Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)
HDR videos play with their full colors and brightness. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Meta platform decoupling (4XVR)

Keeps the Meta store calls out of the way, so 4XVR starts instead of hanging on its splash screen. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Popup refresh on resume (4XVR)
Re-checks the first-launch prompts after you return from system settings. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Premium unlock (4XVR, experimental)

Unlocks premium playback without a store check on Galaxy XR, where the store cannot be reached. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Render dispatch payload (4XVR)

Adds the scene-timing engine that keeps 4XVR visuals and screens in step with the frames. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Startup and UI continuity helper (4XVR)

Keeps the startup greeting and on-screen notifications working when the app rebuilds its display. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Subtitle suite (4XVR)
Moves subtitles around, enlarges the subtitle panel and loads your own subtitle font. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
Subtitle suite payload (4XVR)
Adds the subtitle engine used by the 4XVR subtitle controls. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
